_doc: Per-provider narrator settings. max_pause caps pauses inside a line (seconds at punctuation, 0.6x between words; see tts.py tighten). Keys/secrets never go here; they come from .env (see .env.example). A cut picks its provider in its script/cut JSON (voice.provider) and can be overridden on the command line: scripts/tts.py --provider doubao.
